dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains the boundaries of the City of Cambridge's thirteen neighborhoods.

Purpose: Created for the establishment of neighborhood planning groups, administration of Community Development Block Group (CDBG) programs, Community Development Department (CDD) staff allocation, and for mapping and analysis purposes.
